description: April 22 birthday meaning: Taurus decan 1, birthday number 22, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an April 22 birthday falls in Taurus, in the first decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 22. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Taurus is fixed and earth.

sections.heading: The April 22 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Master number 22, the master builder, sits beautifully with fixed earth on April 22. The Sun is about two degrees into Taurus, where Venus rules sign and decan alike. Interpreters see someone with a gift for making lasting, beautiful things, such as gardens, homes or businesses, and the patience to keep building long after others tire.

Astronomically, April 22 puts the Sun near 2° Taurus in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Venus. With Venus as both ruler and sub-ruler, the first decan of Taurus is traditionally seen as the sign at its most sensuous and steady. Birthdays from about April 20 to April 30 land here. The emphasis is on comfort that has been earned: texture, taste, music and the slow pleasure of things done well. This doubled Venus tone is often linked with loyalty and a calm, grounding presence that friends lean on. It can also make change feel like an imposition rather than an invitation. Those born in this decan tend to flourish when they treat flexibility as another form of care, not a threat to it.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for April 22
paragraphs: A birthday on the 22nd gives a birthday number of 22, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced. Sometimes called the Master Builder, 22 combines the 2's cooperation with the 4's practicality on a larger scale, suggesting an ability to turn big visions into working structures. Even in the secondary position of a birth day, it is given weight in numerology. People born on this day are often described as idealistic planners, capable of organising many people towards a shared goal. Pressure can come with that potential, so pacing themselves tends to matter a great deal.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: an April 22 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 11 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 33. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous April 22 birthdays
paragraphs: April birthdays arrive in full northern spring, with lengthening days and fast growth; in the southern hemisphere the month belongs to mid-autumn and harvest. Aries carries most of April, handing over to Taurus around April 19 or 20. As month 4, April brings numerology's number of structure, steadiness and hard work, a grounding counterweight to the quick fire of the month's early birthdays. April 22 is the 112nd day of the year (113rd in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Gemini, is usually complete within 29 days, by May 21.

By April 22 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with an April 22 birthday are Vladimir Lenin (1870), Immanuel Kant (1724) and J. Robert Oppenheimer (1904).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is April 22?
faq.answer: April 22 is Taurus in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Taurus, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on April 22?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On April 22 the Life Path is 33 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 11 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 22 for everyone born on the 22nd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on April 22?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by April 22, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on April 22?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on April 22 include Vladimir Lenin (1870), Immanuel Kant (1724) and J. Robert Oppenheimer (1904). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
